bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to state government; requiring meetings of the Minnesota Historical Society to be open to the public and the Minnesota Historical Society's data to be public data as to state-owned properties; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 138.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[138.255] MEETINGS AND DATA REGARDING STATE-OWNED PROPERTIES. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Meetings of the executive council.+]

[+A meeting in which the executive council discusses, makes decisions regarding, or receives information related to state-owned historic sites under section 138.662, state-owned historic places designated under section 138.663, or state-owned places on the National Register of Historic Places, is subject to chapter 13D. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Public data.+]

[+Data maintained by the Minnesota Historical Society related to state-owned historic sites under section 138.662, state-owned historic places designated under section 138.663, and state-owned places on the National Register of Historic Places is public data, as defined in section 13.02, subdivisions 14 and 15. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to state government; requiring meetings of the Minnesota Historical Society to be open to the public and the Minnesota Historical Society's data to be public data as to state-owned properties; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 138.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[138.255] MEETINGS AND DATA REGARDING STATE-OWNED PROPERTIES.

Subdivision 1.

Meetings of the executive council.

A meeting in which the executive council discusses, makes decisions regarding, or receives information related to state-owned historic sites under section 138.662, state-owned historic places designated under section 138.663, or state-owned places on the National Register of Historic Places, is subject to chapter 13D.

Subd. 2.

Public data.

Data maintained by the Minnesota Historical Society related to state-owned historic sites under section 138.662, state-owned historic places designated under section 138.663, and state-owned places on the National Register of Historic Places is public data, as defined in section 13.02, subdivisions 14 and 15.
additions: [138.255] MEETINGS AND DATA REGARDING STATE-OWNED PROPERTIES.

A meeting in which the executive council discusses, makes decisions regarding, or receives information related to state-owned historic sites under section 138.662, state-owned historic places designated under section 138.663, or state-owned places on the National Register of Historic Places, is subject to chapter 13D.

Data maintained by the Minnesota Historical Society related to state-owned historic sites under section 138.662, state-owned historic places designated under section 138.663, and state-owned places on the National Register of Historic Places is public data, as defined in section 13.02, subdivisions 14 and 15.
